jobs.company: Jai Hind College Incubator and Accelerator Centre
jobs.title: Portfolio Manager
jobs.description:
🔥 WE’RE HIRING: Portfolio Manager

📍 Location:
Dubai, United Arab Emirates
🕒 Employment Type:
Part-Time
🌐 Work Arrangement:
Hybrid
💼 Experience Level:
Mid-Level to Senior
📊 Manage strategic portfolios. Optimize performance. Create long-term value!
🚀
Are you an analytical professional with strong investment, financial, or portfolio management expertise? We’re looking for a proactive Portfolio Manager to oversee portfolio performance, evaluate risks, develop strategies, and support informed decision-making. If you enjoy analyzing opportunities, balancing priorities, and achieving strategic objectives, this could be your next career opportunity! 💼✨
📌 Role Responsibilities 📈 Develop and implement portfolio strategies aligned with organizational or client objectives.
📊 Monitor portfolio performance, financial indicators, and progress against targets.
🔍 Analyze market trends, investment opportunities, and portfolio risks.
💰 Support asset allocation, resource planning, and performance optimization.
🛡️ Identify potential risks and recommend appropriate mitigation strategies.
📝 Prepare portfolio reports, performance reviews, and management presentations.
🤝 Coordinate with clients, stakeholders, analysts, and relevant departments.
📋 Review portfolio objectives and recommend adjustments when business conditions change.
🔐 Ensure portfolio activities follow applicable policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.
🚀 Identify opportunities to improve returns, operational efficiency, or strategic value, depending on portfolio objectives.

🎯 Qualifications 🎓 Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Investment Management, or a related field preferred.
💼 Experience in portfolio management, investment analysis, asset management, or financial planning is an advantage.
📊 Strong financial modeling, analytical, and quantitative skills.
🧠 Excellent strategic thinking, research, and decision-making abilities.
💻 Proficiency in Excel and relevant financial analysis or portfolio management tools.
🛡️ Understanding of portfolio risk, performance measurement, and reporting.
🗣️ Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills.
🏅 Relevant professional qualifications, such as CFA, are an advantage for investment-focused roles.

✨ Why Join Us? 🚀 Contribute to strategic portfolio decisions and performance improvement.
📈 Develop your expertise in analysis, risk assessment, and portfolio strategy.
🤝 Collaborate with professionals across multiple business functions.
💼 Gain exposure to complex portfolio planning and reporting.
🌟 Build your professional capabilities in a results-oriented environment.

📩 APPLY NOW! Ready to take the next step in your portfolio management career? Send us your updated CV and highlight your relevant experience, analytical expertise, and portfolio achievements. We welcome motivated professionals who are ready to turn insights into meaningful results! 📄✨
